bio.text: Jordan J.G. Wright represents District 70 in Harlem in the New York State Assembly, and his official biography says he took his seat in January 2025.
He is a lifelong New Yorker and a resident of Central Harlem who graduated from Syracuse University in 2017 with a degree in psychology.
Before the Assembly he worked as an educator in Manhattan schools and was Chief of Staff to New York City Council Member Yusef Salaam.
